sources.name: DGCA domestic city-pair traffic (monthly passengers), aggregated by Vonter/india-aviation-traffic
sources.note: Directional passengers City1→City2; city arrivals sum all routes into the city. City names normalised (Goa = Dabolim + Mopa; Mumbai incl. Navi Mumbai). The source file has no rows for 2021-05 and 2024-05: those months are imputed (last year x neighbouring year-on-year ratios) and flagged imputed=true.

sources.name: Singapore Department of Statistics / Singapore Tourism Board
sources.note: Occupied hotel room nights, all of Singapore (snapshot in src/data/singapore-gross-lettings.json).

anomalies.reason: COVID-19: national lockdown from 25 Mar 2020, domestic flights resumed 25 May 2020 under capacity caps (lifted 18 Oct 2021), Omicron wave Jan-Feb 2022.
COVID-19: border closures and quarantine-hotel use until Singapore reopened to vaccinated travellers on 1 Apr 2022.
